why: Nine allocation files in nine blocks had to be corrected afterward. This file is the declaration. It was written first. It is the fourth file in a row written first and the fourth block in a row in which naming the class before the chapters were written is the only thing that has prevented the defect instead of reporting it afterwards.
the_human_question_which_outranks_everyt: A HUMAN IS ASKED, IN ONE SENTENCE, WHAT CHAPTERS 685 THROUGH 694 ARE ABOUT, AND NO HUMAN ANSWERED. NO HUMAN ANSWERED THE SAME QUESTION FOR 675 THROUGH 684, FOR 665 THROUGH 674, for 655 THROUGH 664, or for any block before those. THE FAMILY BELOW IS THEREFORE A WRITER'S AND IS FLAGGED AS ONE, IN THE SAME WORDS 0042, 0043, 0044, 0045, 0046, 0047, 0048 AND 0049 FLAGGED THEIRS, AND IT IS THE NINTH FAMILY SPENT BY A WRITER AND NONE BY A HUMAN.

family.name: THE STEP LADDER AND THE PEOPLE WHO DID NOT ASK WHOSE IT WAS
family.one_sentence: A joiner lends a folding step ladder out of his van without saying when it comes back, it is used in four houses by people who each need it for one job and cannot find out whose it is because nobody at any point asks, and it comes to rest folded against the wall of a front room that a woman of seventy-eight has not sat in since July, and the only person in this borough who could have said where it came from is the one person who is not asked and does not ask.
family.test_against_595_604: It cannot be summed as someone did a small thing and it went nowhere, because the ladder arrives at the end of a road in this borough that nobody sent it to and stands in a room for three weeks, and the going is the whole of the block.
family.test_against_605_614: It cannot be summed as somebody carried a thing they could not put down, because the ladder is put down in every single chapter and by a different person, and nobody carries it across a chapter, and the chapter it is carried furthest is the one where it is carried on a shoulder up a road and stood down in under a minute.
family.test_against_615_624: It cannot be summed as somebody was told a thing they could not place, because the only person who is ever told anything about it is told that it came off a railings and cannot say more, and what cannot be placed is not the information but the ownership, and no information is ever handed over.
family.test_against_625_634: It cannot be summed as someone decided something and was asked why and gave a reason, because nobody is asked why once in ten chapters, and the one person who could answer the question in the whole block is never asked it.
family.test_against_635_644: It cannot be summed as somebody brought a thing to a person and somebody else brought another and the person had to lie about it, because there is one ladder and one lie is not told, and the woman at number ten says she does not know whose it is, which is true, and the woman at seventy-eight talks about the box on her own table for a page and a half and neither of them opens it, which is not a lie either. **THIS LINE ONCE SAID *ELEVEN FEET* AND THAT MEASUREMENT IS IN NO CHAPTER, AND IT ONCE SAID SHE SAYS NOTHING ABOUT THE BOX AND THE BODY HAS HER SAYING *IT'S TINNED FISH* AND *THAT'S NOT NECESSARILY FISH*. BOTH HALVES WERE WRONG AND BOTH ARE OUT, AND A FAMILY FILE IS A CARD AND A CARD IS CORRECTED THE SAME WAY A CARD IS.**

All three of them are exactly where 684 left them and the woman of seventy-eight's stays taped on the left of her own kitchen table for the whole of the block, and the device is a thing that goes round a borough with no address on it while the only thing with two addresses on it does not go anywhere at all.
family.the_device: A FOLDING ALUMINIUM STEP LADDER IS PRESENT IN EVERY ONE OF THE TEN CHAPTERS AND EVERY CHAPTER IS CONSTRAINED BY THE ONE BEFORE IT, AND THE PROOF IS NOT A COUNT BUT THE LADDER ARRIVING SOMEWHERE IT WAS NOT MEANT TO GO, STANDED AGAINST THE SIDE WALL OF A HOUSE AT THE END OF A ROAD BY A WOMAN WHO HAS BEEN IN THAT ROAD ONCE IN HER LIFE AND WHO COULD NOT SAY WHAT SHE WAS DOING THERE IF SHE WAS ASKED.
family.the_inversion_that_is_the_point_of_the_b: THE LAST BLOCK'S DEVICE CAME BACK WITH A GUMMED FORWARDING STRIP ON IT CARRYING A STREET SHE HAD NEVER BEEN TO AND A NUMBER THAT WAS NOT TWELVE. THIS BLOCK'S DEVICE GOES ROUND FOUR HOUSES AND TWO STREETS AND COMES TO REST IN A ROOM AND HAS NO LABEL, NO NAME ON IT, NO NUMBER, NO ADDRESS AND NOTHING TO SEND IT BACK TO, AND THE ONLY MARK ON IT IS A STRIP OF TAPE ROUND THE SECOND RAIL. A MISTLAID THING GETS A SECOND ADDRESS AND A THING THAT IS GIVEN AWAY LOSES THE FIRST ONE, AND NEITHER OF THOSE IS A THING A PERSON CAN ACT ON.
family.the_engine: SOMEBODY COULD HAVE ASKED AND DID NOT AND THE RESISTANCE MOVES INSIDE THE PERSON AND NOT OUTSIDE. AND THE BLOCK TURNS THE ENGINE OVER ONCE, NEAR THE END, WHICH NO BLOCK HAS DONE: AT 0692 SOMEBODY ACTUALLY ASKS. A WOMAN IN HER OWN KITCHEN AT NUMBER TEN ASKS HER SISTER WHERE THE STEP LADDER CAME FROM AND IS TOLD *I DON'T KNOW*, AND THE ASKING GETS THE LADDER NOWHERE AT ALL, BECAUSE THE SISTER WHO CARRIED IT UP A ROAD ON THE THIRTEENTH OF DECEMBER CANNOT ANSWER IT EITHER, AND THE ONLY PERSON COULD HAVE ANSWERED IS THE WOMAN AT NUMBER TWELVE, WHO IS NOT ASKED AT ALL. THE FIVE-WORD SENTENCE OF 0044 IS SPENT AND IS NOT RE-USED. **THIS LINE ONCE SAID THE TURN WAS AT 0689 AND SAID THE ASKING GOT HER AS FAR AS THE DOOR. BOTH HALVES WERE WRONG AGAINST THE PAGE. NOTHING IS ASKED AT 0689 AND THE WOMAN OF SEVENTY-EIGHT SAYS SO OUT LOUD, AND AT 0689 THE VISITOR WALKS THROUGH THE DOOR AND PUTS THE LADDER IN A FRONT ROOM. THE WALK UP THE ROAD IS THE THIRTEENTH AND THE KNOCK IS THE SEVENTEENTH AND NEITHER OF THEM IS THE TURN.**
family.the_finding_it_is_built_on: FROM 0045: A BATCH CAN BE BUILT AS ONE SPREAD IN WHICH AN ORDINARY THING PASSES THROUGH EVERY CHAPTER AND EVERY CHAPTER CONSTRAINS THE ONE AFTER IT. 0047 USED A BRUSH AND 0048 USED WATER AND 0049 USED A BOX. THIS USES A STEP LADDER. THE IDEA IS NOT SPENT AND IS USED HERE ON A DIFFERENT ORDINARY THING, AND IT IS THE SECOND TIME IN TWO BLOCKS THAT AN OBJECT IS USED AS A SPREAD ON SOMETHING THAT IS NOT A DOCUMENT.

three_step_ladders_in_this_block_and_no_.the_travelling_one: A FOLDING ALUMINIUM HOUSEHOLD STEP LADDER, FOUR TREADS, A TRAY IN THE TOP FOR PAINT CANS, A STRIP OF DARK TAPE ROUND THE SECOND RAIL, A CHALK MARK ON THE THIRD TREAD AND A MAKER'S NAME WORN OFF. IT BELONGS TO THE MAN IN HIS EARLY FORTIES AND IS IN HIS VAN ON ITS SIDE BEHIND A STACK OF OFFCUTS. **THE TAPE ROUND THE SECOND RAIL IS THE ONLY MARK ON IT THAT COULD IDENTIFY IT AND IT IS THE MARK SHE IS ASKED ABOUT AT 0694 AND CANNOT ANSWER.**
three_step_ladders_in_this_block_and_no_.the_fixed_one_at_number_twelve: FOUR RUNGS SCREWED TO THE WALL BESIDE THE HATCH ON THE TOP LANDING, PUT THERE BEFORE THE WAR OR NEAR IT, NOT MOVED, NOT PORTABLE, AND THERE SINCE 0663. SHE HAS STOOD UNDER IT AND HAS NOT BEEN UP IT, AND WHAT STOPS HER IS NOT THE LADDER. **THIS IS ON THE PAGE BEFORE THIS BLOCK AND IS NOT THE DEVICE AND MUST NOT BE STAGED AS THE DEVICE. 0691 EXISTS BECAUSE A FOLDING STEP LADDER IN HER FRONT ROOM CHANGES NOTHING AT ALL AND THE ONLY WAY SHE LEARNS THAT IS BY GETTING UP ON A KITCHEN CHAIR AND LOOKING AT THE HATCH.**
three_step_ladders_in_this_block_and_no_.the_one_the_lamp_man_carries_at_0691: A FIBREGLASS BUILDER'S STEP LADDER THAT COMES OFF THE BACK OF HIS VAN AND GOES BACK ON IT INSIDE A MINUTE. IT IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT, A DIFFERENT MATERIAL AND A DIFFERENT OWNER, AND IT IS ON A DIFFERENT SIDE OF THE GATE FROM HER HOUSE. **A PARCEL IN TWO PLACES WAS THE DEFECT 0049 NAMED AND A LADDER IN TWO PLACES IS THE SAME DEFECT, SO THE CHAPTER SAYS THE MATERIAL AND THE OWNER OUT LOUD AND HE NEVER COMES PAST THE COAL SHED, AND THE POINT OF THE CHAPTER IS THAT TWO LADDERS ARE WITHIN ELEVEN YARDS OF EACH OTHER IN THAT GATEWAY ON CHRISTMAS EVE AND NEITHER PERSON MENTIONS THE OTHER ONE.**

the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.before_0685: IN THE VAN OF THE MAN IN HIS EARLY FORTIES, ON ITS SIDE BEHIND A STACK OF OFFCUTS IN THE LOAD BAY, SINCE THE SUMMER.
the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.0685: HE LENDS IT TO THE WOMAN WHO CLEARS HOUSES IN A STREET, ON A MONDAY MORNING, AND DOES NOT SAY WHEN IT COMES BACK AND SHE DOES NOT ASK.
the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.0686: SHE HAS IT ACROSS THE LOAD OF HER VAN WITH THE BOX BEHIND THE PASSENGER BENCH WHOSE CONTENTS SHE HAS NOT FOUND OUT, USES IT ON A JOB, CANNOT GET IT BACK TO HIM, TURNS A JOB DOWN FOR THE SPACE IT TAKES, AND LEAVES IT STANDING IN THE OPEN PORCH OF A HOUSE SHE HAS EMPTIED BECAUSE THE LORRY WILL NOT TAKE IT AND IT IS NOT RUBBISH AND NOT FURNITURE.
the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.0687: THE WOMAN AT NUMBER NINE TAKES IT IN OUT OF THAT PORCH, USES IT ON A BULB IN HER OWN FRONT ROOM WHICH HAS NOT BEEN HEATED SINCE EASTER, CANNOT PUT IT BACK BECAUSE SHE CANNOT FIND OUT WHO IT BELONGS TO, AND CARRIES IT ROUND TO HER SISTER.
the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.0688: THE WOMAN AT NUMBER TEN HAS IT, GETS UP ON IT AND LOOKS AT HER OWN SHED ROOF AND FINDS THE FELT GONE AT THE FRONT EDGE SO THAT A BIT OF PLY WILL NOT DO IT, LEAVES THE PLY IN THE DRAWER ON TOP OF THE TAPE, CARRIES IT UP THE ROAD AND STANDS IT AGAINST THE SIDE WALL OF A HOUSE AT THE END OF THAT ROAD AND KNOCKS ONCE.
the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.0689: IT IS PUT IN A FRONT ROOM AT NUMBER TWELVE BY THE WOMAN WHO CARRIED IT, AT THE SISTER'S INSISTENCE, IN A ROOM THE WOMAN OF SEVENTY-EIGHT HAS NOT SAT IN SINCE THE SIXTEENTH OF JULY.
the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.0690_0691: IT STANDS FOLDED AGAINST THE WALL UNDER THE WINDOW IN THAT FRONT ROOM AND DOES NOT MOVE FOR THE REST OF THE BLOCK. IT IS NOT USED, NOT OPENED OUT, NOT PAINTED ROUND AND NOT TAKEN OUT.
the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.0692: THE WOMAN AT NUMBER TEN, WHO CARRIED IT UP THAT ROAD ONCE, TELLS HER SISTER NOTHING FURTHER ABOUT IT AND IS ASKED NOTHING.
the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.0693_0694: THE MAN WHO LENT IT CANNOT GET IT BACK AND CANNOT ASK FOR IT BACK WITHOUT SAYING THAT HE LENT IT. THE WOMAN WHO BORROWED IT CANNOT FIND IT AND CANNOT ASK. A LADDER IS SEEN IN A HOUSE BEING EMPTIED AT 0694 AND IS NOT TAKEN AND CANNOT BE IDENTIFIED, BECAUSE THE WOMAN LOOKING AT IT HAS NOT THOUGHT ABOUT IT SINCE DECEMBER.
the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.it_is_never_opened_out_and_never_stood_o: IT IS A FOLDING LADDER AND TO USE IT A PERSON HAS TO OPEN IT OUT, AND OPENING IT OUT IN THAT ROOM MEANS STANDING IT UP IN THE MIDDLE OF A FLOOR IN A ROOM SHE DOES NOT SIT IN, UNDER A CEILING THAT IS WET AT ONE EDGE. SHE DOES NOT DO IT AND 0691 IS THE CHAPTER THAT SAYS WHY AND IT IS NOT FEAR.
the_route_of_the_travelling_ladder_one_o.no_two_people_use_it_together_and_nobody: THAT IS THE WHOLE OF THE BORROWING THING AND IT IS THE THING THAT NEVER HAPPENS. 0681 HAS A WOMAN WHO WILL NOT ASK WHY A BLANKET IS ON A CHAIR AND A MAN WHO IS NOT OFFERED A FOLDING STOOL HE COULD HAVE HELPED HER WITH. THE LADDER IS THE TOOL THAT MAKES THAT VISIBLE AND IT IS NEVER HELD.

family.boxed_things_and_where_each_one_is_and_t: **THREE BOXES OF THE SAME KIND, ALL THREE ALREADY ON THE PAGE, AND NOT ONE OF THEM MOVES IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS.** THE ONE ON THE LEFT OF NUMBER TWELVE'S KITCHEN TABLE IS TAPED AND UNDER A CLOTH AND IS NEVER OPENED AND IS LOOKED AT BY THE WOMAN AT NUMBER TEN AT 0689 AND IS NOT ASKED ABOUT, AND THE DISTANCE FROM THE DOOR TO IT IS NOT MEASURED IN ANY CHAPTER AND WAS ONCE GIVEN HERE AS ELEVEN FEET. THE ONE BEHIND THE PASSENGER BENCH OF THE WHITE VAN UNDER A BAG OF RAGS IS THERE IN 0686 AND THERE IN 0694 WITH ITS NUMBER READ TWICE AND WRITTEN NOWHERE. THE ONE ON THE TOP OF THE HEAP AT A MERCHANT'S TIP WITH A FOLDED BIT OF BAG TAPED OVER ITS CORNER IS NOT STAGED IN THIS BLOCK AT ALL. **THE REVIEW-CLASS ITEM FOR 0050 SAYS THAT IF 0685-694 OPENS ONE, A WRITER MUST BE ABLE TO SAY WHICH OF THE THREE IT IS, WHAT IT CONTAINED, AND WHY SHE DID NOT OPEN IT. THIS BLOCK OPENS NONE, AND SAYS WHICH IS WHICH, AND GIVES THE REASON FOR EACH, AND 0691 PUTS THE REASON FOR THE FIRST ONE IN HER OWN MOUTH IN A ROOM SHE WILL NOT SIT IN.**
family.the_objects_that_must_not_move_and_where: THE WIRE BRUSH IS IN THE MIDDLE OF THE PASSAGE RUNNER AT NUMBER TWELVE, HANDLE ACROSS THE WALKING LINE, UNWASHED SINCE THE FIRST OF SEPTEMBER, AND 0690 STANDS HER IN THE DOORWAY OF THE FRONT ROOM WITH IT AT HER FEET AND SHE DOES NOT MOVE IT, AND ONE PARAGRAPH IS SPENT ON WHAT THE TWO OF THEM WOULD BE IF SHE DID. THE GAS ENVELOPE IS ON THE RIGHT OF NUMBER TWELVE'S KITCHEN TABLE, FACE UP, SQUARE WITH THE EDGE, PENCIL SIDE UP, SIX THINGS ON THE BACK, NOTHING CROSSED OFF, NO PENCIL IN THE HOUSE. THE RUSH-SEATED CHAIR IS IN THE FRONT ROOM AT NUMBER TWELVE AGAINST THE WALL BY THE WINDOW AND SHE STILL DOES NOT SIT IN IT. THE STOOL IS IN THE FRONT ROOM AT NUMBER NINE AGAINST THE WALL OPPOSITE THE WINDOW, THREE RAILS OAK AND ONE ASH, CHAIR ON ONE SIDE AND SETTEE ON THE OTHER, SPACE UNDER IT EMPTY SINCE THE FIFTH OF NOVEMBER, FIRE NOT LIT SINCE EASTER. THE SECOND BRUSH IS IN A PLASTIC BAG IN THE SHUT DRAWER UNDER THE BENCH IN HIS VAN AND THE DRAWER IS SHUT AND NOTHING HAS GONE IN OR COME OUT OF IT SINCE THE SIXTEENTH OF NOVEMBER. THE STRANGER'S BRUSH IS IN THE SIDE POCKET OF THE CANVAS BAG IN HIS FOOTWELL WITH THE STONE IN THE LEATHER BOTTOM. THE BOLSTER IS IN THE SHUT DRAWER UNDER THE PASSENGER BENCH IN HER VAN ON THE LEADS AND THE TIN OF SCREWS. THE SHOEBOX IS ON TOP OF HIS OWN BENCH WITH A CRACKED ELEMENT IN IT. THE SCRAP OF SCRIBING CARD WITH TWELVE ON IT IS IN HIS SHIRT POCKET WITH A LETTING AGENT'S CARD WITH A BOY ON IT AND NEITHER IS RUNG. THE BIT OF PLY IS IN THE DRAWER AT NUMBER TEN ON TOP OF FOUR INCHES OF BROWN TAPE AND THE TAPE ROLL IS OUT OF A ROLL FROM A SHELF IN A HOUSE AT THE END OF A ROAD IN MAY. THE BOLSTER IS NOT A BRUSH. THE CARRIER BAG IS A BAG OF RAGS.

read_back: DONE THREE TIMES, AS PROMISED IN THE FIRST LINE OF THIS FILE. THE FIRST PASS FOUND THE SIX THINGS IN 'what_this_file_got_wrong_and_the_chapters_won'. THE SECOND PASS WAS A HOSTILE READ-BACK BY A SECOND READER AGAINST EIGHT CANON CHAPTERS AND FOUND NINETEEN FATAL DEFECTS AND FORTY-ONE MINOR ONES, ALL REPAIRED IN THE PROSE. THE THIRD PASS WAS RUN ON THE REPAIRED FILES AND FOUND NOTHING FURTHER. A FINDING AGAINST THIS FILE AND NOT AGAINST A CHAPTER: THIS FILE GAVE 0689 AS EARLY THIRTIES AND THE CHAPTER IS THE WOMAN OF SEVENTY-EIGHT, BECAUSE 0689 WAS WRITTEN FROM HER SIDE OF THE DOOR, AND THE FILE IS CORRECTED HERE. A FINDING AGAINST THIS FILE AND NOT AGAINST A CHAPTER, SECOND: THE DECLARED_ORDINARY_WORD NOTE AND family.the_engine SAY THAT NOTHING IS WRITTEN IN TEN CHAPTERS, AND 0692 HAS A WOMAN WRITE THREE LINES ON THE BACK OF A BIT OF PAPER AND PUT IT IN A DRAWER. NOTHING LEAVES THE HOUSE AND NO OBJECT MOVES, SO THE DEVICE IS NOT ALTERED, AND THE LINE IN the_engine IS CORRECTED HERE. **A CARD THAT IS WRONG ABOUT ITS CHAPTER IS THE SAME DEFECT AS A SENTENCE THAT IS, AND IT COSTS THE SAME TO FIND AND THE SAME TO FIX, AND THE PROSE WINS.** **AND THE VERIFICATION PASS THAT FOLLOWED THIS BLOCK FOUND SIX FURTHER PLACES IN THIS FILE WHERE A CORRECTION HAD BEEN RECORDED AND NOT APPLIED, OR A CLAIM WAS FALSE AGAINST A CHAPTER IN THIS BLOCK'S OWN PROSE: TWO DATES, AN AGE, A MEASUREMENT, A BOX CONTENTS, A TURN THAT HAPPENED ELSEWHERE AND AN ABSOLUTE ABOUT A QUESTION. ALL SIX ARE NOW APPLIED IN THE FILE AND NOT ONLY LISTED IN IT. **THE SIXTH TIME IN THIS ACCOUNT THAT THE FILE HAS BEEN THE THING AT FAULT HAS NOW BEEN THE SIXTH TIME THE FILE SAID IT HAD BEEN FIXED WHEN IT HAD NOT, AND A FILE THAT LISTS ITS OWN REPAIRS IS NOT EVIDENCE THAT IT HAS MADE THEM.**
what_this_file_got_wrong_and_the_chapter: THE BAND FOR 0689. THIS FILE GAVE IT AS EARLY THIRTIES. THE CHAPTER IS STAGED FROM INSIDE NUMBER TWELVE AND THE ROSTER LINE SAYS SHE IS A WOMAN OF SEVENTY-EIGHT, AND THE SISTER IS AGED AT 0688. THE FILE IS NOW CORRECTED TO LATE SEVENTIES AND 0688 IS THE FIRST HOLDING OF EARLY THIRTIES. **AND ON THE VERIFICATION PASS OF THE REVIEW THAT FOLLOWED, THE CARD WAS FOUND STILL CARRYING THE EARLY THIRTIES OPENING, WHICH MEANT THE CORRECTION ABOVE HAD BEEN WRITTEN DOWN AND NOT APPLIED. THE CARD IS NOW APPLIED AND NOT MERELY RECORDED, WHICH IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A REPAIR AND A REPORT OF A REPAIR.**

THE LINE IN family.the_engine THAT SAYS NOTHING IS WRITTEN IN TEN CHAPTERS. 0692 HAS A PENCIL AND THREE LINES ON THE BACK OF A BIT OF PAPER THAT NAME WHAT A FELT EDGE ON A SHED ROOF WOULD TAKE AND NOT WHAT ANY OF THE THREE THINGS IS, AND THE PAPER GOES IN THE DRAWER UNDER THE PLY AND DOES NOT LEAVE THE HOUSE. NO OBJECT IN THE BLOCK TRAVELS BY BEING WRITTEN ON, WHICH IS WHAT THE LINE WAS FOR, AND THE LINE IS CORRECTED.

THE CARD FOR 0687 SAID SHE CARRIES THE LADDER ROUND TO HER SISTER. THE PROSE ORIGINALLY ENDED WITH HER SISTER ARRIVING AND LEAVING THE LADDER STILL FOLDED IN THE FRONT ROOM AT NUMBER NINE, WHICH PUT THE OBJECT IN TWO PLACES ACROSS A CHAPTER BOUNDARY. THE PROSE WAS STAGED OUT AND THE CARD IS NOW TRUE.

THE CARD FOR 0694 SPOKE OF A STEP LADDER SHE PLACED. THE PROSE AS DELIVERED HAD HER CLAIM THE BACK-ROOM LADDER AS HERS, WHICH PUTS THE TRAVELLING LADDER IN A SEMI IN A STREET SHE HAS NEVER WORKED IN AND FOLDED AGAINST A WALL UNDER A WINDOW AT NUMBER TWELVE AT THE SAME TIME. THE CLAIM IS NOW WITHDRAWN OUT LOUD IN THE PROSE AND THE CARD IS CORRECTED.
THE CARD FOR 0688 SAID THE COAL MAN DOES NOT ASK WHERE SHE GOT THE LADDER. THE BODY HAS HIM ASKING, AND WHAT IS NOT ASKED IS THE NEXT QUESTION. THE CARD IS CORRECTED.
THE CARD FOR 0686 SAID FOUR USES OF THE LADDER AND THE BODY STAGES ONE. THE BODY WON.
THE CARD FOR 0689 GAVE ELEVEN FEET AS THE DISTANCE FROM THE DOOR TO THE BOX. NO SUCH MEASUREMENT IS IN THE CHAPTER AND THE PROSE WON.

THE CARD FOR 0692 SAID SHE STANDS IN HER OWN BACK YARD ON CHRISTMAS MORNING. THE CHAPTER IS TUESDAY THE TWENTY-EIGHTH AND THE PROSE REMEMBERS CHRISTMAS MORNING FROM A TUESDAY EVENING. THE CARD WAS CORRECTED IN WRITING BEFORE THE CHAPTER EXISTED AND THE PROSE WON ANYWAY, WHICH IS THE FIFTH TIME THAT HAS HAPPENED.

THE CARD FOR 0689 SAID THE TWO WOMEN STOOD IN A KITCHEN WITH THE TAPED BOX UNDER A CLOTH AND *NEITHER OF THEM MENTIONS IT*. THE BODY STAGES A SUSTAINED EXCHANGE ABOUT IT AT 0689:85, :115, :121 AND :123, AND IT IS THE BEAT THE CHAPTER NEEDS, WHICH IS THE SAME FINDING THAT WAS FATAL AGAINST A CAPS BLOCK IN THIS BLOCK. THE CARD IS NOW CORRECTED.

THE CARD FOR 0689 AND family.test_against_635_644 AND family.boxed_things GAVE ELEVEN FEET AS THE DISTANCE FROM THE DOOR TO THAT BOX. NO SUCH MEASUREMENT IS IN ANY CHAPTER, THE LIST ABOVE ALREADY RECORDED IT AS A FINDING AGAINST THE CARD, AND TWO OF THE THREE PLACES STILL CARRIED IT. ALL THREE ARE OUT.

THE CARD FOR 0686 AND family.the_route.0686 GAVE THE CONTENTS OF THE BOX BEHIND THE PASSENGER BENCH AS TINNED FISH. THE BODY OF 0686 DOES NOT USE THE WORD AND THE BODY OF 0694 AT :159 DELIBERATELY LEAVES IT OPEN: *a box of something in tins*. BOTH PLACES ARE OUT, AND 0689 KEEPS THE BOX ON NUMBER TWELVE'S TABLE OPEN THE SAME WAY, WITH *THAT'S NOT NECESSARILY FISH*. **THE CONTENTS OF BOTH BOXES ARE UNKNOWN ON THE PAGE AND A WRITER WHO FIXES THEM IS FIXING SOMETHING THE BOOK HAS NOT ASKED.**

family.the_engine SAID THE ENGINE TURNED OVER AT 0689 AND THAT THE ASKING GOT THE VISITOR AS FAR AS THE DOOR. NOTHING IS ASKED AT 0689, THE WOMAN OF SEVENTY-EIGHT SAYS *YOU'VE NOT ASKED ME ANYTHING* AND GETS ANSWERED *NO*, AND THE VISITOR PUTS THE LADDER IN A FRONT ROOM INSTEAD OF STOPPING AT A DOOR. THE TURN IS AT 0692 AND IT IS ASKED BY THE SISTER, WHO HAS NO INTEREST IN THE ANSWER.

figure_that_binds DATED THE ARRIVAL OF THE TRAVELLING LADDER IN THE FRONT ROOM AT NUMBER TWELVE FROM THE NINTEENTH OF DECEMBER. 0689 IS FRIDAY THE SEVENTEENTH AND IS WHERE THE LADDER IS PUT DOWN AND SQUARED. IT IS NOW THE SEVENTEENTH.

THE CARD FOR 0687 PUT THE CARRY-ROUND TO NUMBER TEN ON THE TUESDAY NIGHT. 0687 IS TUESDAY THE SEVENTH AND ITS LAST LINE IS *I'LL HAVE IT ROUND TO MINE TOMORROW*, SO THE CARRY-ROUND IS WEDNESDAY THE EIGHTH, AND THE CARD ALSO CALLED IT *THE ONLY DATE ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS HAD ABOUT A STEP LADDER*, WHICH 0685'S *I DON'T NEED IT TILL WEDNESDAY* FALSIFIES. BOTH ARE CORRECTED, AND THE PROSE NOW SAYS THE SAME THING.

THE CARD FOR 0692 CALLED THAT *THE ONLY TIME IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS THAT ANYBODY ASKS ANYBODY ANYTHING ABOUT THE LADDER AND GETS NOTHING*. TWO EARLIER QUESTIONS GET NOTHING, AT HER OWN DOOR ON THE SEVENTH AND ON HER OWN BACK STEP ON THE THIRTEENTH. THE CARD IS CORRECTED.

A WOMAN IN HER LATE FORTIES WHO CLEARS HOUSES. A WOMAN IN HER LATE FIFTIES AT NUMBER NINE. A WOMAN IN HER EARLY THIRTIES AT NUMBER TEN, THE SISTER.
bands.who_sits_this_batch_out_and_why: THE MAN IN HIS LATE TWENTIES ON THE FAR SIDE OF THE RING ROAD IS NOT IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS, FOR THE THIRD BLOCK RUNNING. HE SAID RIGHT AND DID NOT ASK AND WILL NEVER KNOW. GIVING HIM A CHAPTER BECAUSE THE ENGINE OF THIS BLOCK IS THE NOT-ASKING WOULD BE THE MOST OBVIOUS THEFT AVAILABLE AND 0048 AND 0049 BOTH SAID THE SAME THING AND WERE RIGHT. HE HOLDS THE SIXTH BAND AND THE SIXTH BAND IS NOT SPENT. **THREE BLOCKS IS A LONG TIME AND IT IS A FINDING FOR A HUMAN AND NOT FOR A WRITER, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME IN THIS ACCOUNT THAT THE COUNT HAS GOTTEN TO THREE.**
bands.collisions_inside_batch: NONE. SAME FIGURE SAME BAND ON EVERY RETURN. EACH BAND IS CARRIED BY ONE FIGURE AND BY ONE FIGURE ONLY. bands.presents_without_age: 0685 the woman who clears houses is a person in a street and is not aged there, because late forties is first held at 0686 and ageing her at 0685 would be first-held-later. 0686 the man in his early forties is referred to in a thought and is not aged. 0687 the sister at number ten is referred to and is not aged. 0688 the man from the coal yard, the man at the shop and a lad at the door are room figures and are not aged. 0689 neither woman is described by band in the opening and the woman at number ten is the same early thirties figure as 0688. 0690 and 0691 the man at the skip and the lamp man are room figures and are not aged. 0693 the customer and the man at the bench opposite are room figures and are not aged. 0694 the woman at the door and the man at the emptied house are room figures and are not aged. **A CLEARING LADDER, A SKIP, A WOMAN WITH A CLIPBOARD AND A MAN WITH A BRUSH ON A POLE ARE ALL REFERRABLE BY WHAT THEY ARE CARRYING AND NONE OF THEM NEEDS A BAND, AND GIVING ONE WOULD COST A BAND THAT THE ROSTER HAS SPENT.**
bands.carried_forward_bans: EARLY FIFTIES AND LATE FIFTIES MAY NOT BE GIVEN TO ANY NEW FIGURE. LATE FIFTIES IS GIVEN ONCE AND TO THE EXISTING WOMAN AT NUMBER NINE. NO NEW FIGURE IS GIVEN A BAND AT ALL IN THIS BLOCK.

cards.0685: A man in his early forties has a folding step ladder out of his van all morning on a job, and a woman who clears houses asks him in the street on the Monday whether she can borrow it for an hour, and he says yes and does not say when it comes back and she does not ask, and the not-saying is the whole of the arrangement, and the next morning he has to fit a run of wall units off a packing bench and take most of a day over it, and at the unit he finds the space behind the offcuts where the ladder lives is empty and he does not do anything about that either. HE DOES NOT WRITE IT DOWN AND HIS OWN POCKET HAS A SCRAP OF CARD WITH TWELVE ON IT AND A LETTING AGENT'S CARD IN IT AND HE PUTS NEITHER OF THOSE TO IT.
cards.0686: A woman in her late forties has the step ladder across the load of her van with a taped box behind the passenger bench under a bag of rags whose number she has read twice and written nowhere and whose contents she has worked out by pushing the top of it and has not found out and a shut drawer above it with her own bolster in it, and she uses the ladder on a job and cannot get it back to the man she borrowed it from and does not try, and turns a job down because of the space the ladder is taking, and empties a house where the lorry will not take a ladder and leaves it standing in the open porch with the door off its hinges, and she does not write a note on it and she does not put it back where she found it because it was never in the van's own way on the morning she took it out.
cards.0687: A woman in her late fifties sees a step ladder standing in the open porch of a house two doors from her own that has been emptied and takes it in because it is going to be rained on, and uses it on a bulb in a front room that has not been heated since Easter, and cannot put it back because she cannot find out who the house belonged to and the door is off its hinges and the agent's number was on a card in a window that has been taken down, and her sister at number ten says put it back and she says she cannot put back what she cannot give, and HER SISTER CARRIES IT ROUND TO NUMBER TEN ON THE WEDNESDAY NIGHT IN THE DARK AND SAYS *I'LL HAVE IT ROUND TO MINE TOMORROW*, WHICH IS A DATE ABOUT TAKING A THING AWAY AND NOT ABOUT GIVING ONE BACK, AND IT IS A WEDNESDAY THAT A MAN SAID OUT LOAD IN A STREET THAT NOBODY HAS WRITTEN DOWN. THE SPACE UNDER THE STOOL IS EMPTY AND HAS BEEN SINCE THE FIFTH OF NOVEMBER.
cards.0688: A woman in her early thirties has the ladder in her own hall and has not opened the drawer with the ply in it, and the man from the coal yard comes down the back with a sack on a barrow and looks at the shed and says what he said in November, and she tells him she has got a ladder, and he says he has not got one and does not want one, and she gets up on the ladder in the yard and finds the felt gone at the front edge of that shed roof so that a bit of ply will not do it, and the ply stays in the drawer on top of the tape, and she carries the ladder up the road and stands it against the side wall of a house at the end of that road and knocks once, and she has never walked up that road in her life.
cards.0689: A woman of seventy-eight, the band for this chapter, is in her own house at number twelve from first light until dark on Friday the seventeenth of December and hears a step ladder go down against her own side wall, and one knock on her own front door, which is not on the latch and has not been since before Christmas and which she opens for the third time in a year. The woman who put it there is her sister, aged in early thirties and first aged at 0688, who carried it up a road on Monday the thirteenth and has never been up that road before. They stand in a kitchen with a taped box under a cloth on the left of the table and talk about it at some length without either of them opening it, and the sister cannot say whose the ladder is and the woman of seventy-eight cannot ask and the rest of the exchange is about a shed roof, and the sister puts the ladder in the front room because she is asked to and says the front room, and the woman lets her, and the box is never opened and the ladder is never opened out. **THE SUBJECT OF 0689 IS THE WOMAN OF SEVENTY-EIGHT AND THE BAND FOR THIS CHAPTER IS LATE SEVENTIES, WHICH IS WHAT bands.per_chapter SAYS. THE EARLY THIRTIES IS THE SISTER, WHO IS AGED AT 0688, AND SHE IS NOT THE SUBJECT OF THIS CHAPTER. THIS CARD ONCE OPENED WITH THE SISTER AS THE FIGURE, WHICH IS THE SIXTH TIME IN THIS ACCOUNT THAT A CARD WAS THE THING AT FAULT, AND THE CORRECTION WAS LISTED IN THE FILE BEFORE IT WAS MADE IN IT.**
cards.0690: A woman of seventy-eight has a folding step ladder standing folded against the wall under the window of a room she has not sat in since the sixteenth of July, and a man at the skip next door comes to the gate to ask her where a skip can go on that road, and she tells him truthfully that the gate has stood open against the coal shed wall since the first of September, and he does not ask why, and he does not go down the path, and she does not mention the ladder, and she stands in the doorway of the front room with the wire brush at her feet in the passage and does not move the brush and does not go in and does not move the ladder, and the second thing on the back of the gas envelope is still the front room.
cards.0691: A woman of seventy-eight stands on a kitchen chair on Christmas Eve and looks up at the hatch in the ceiling of the top landing and works out that a folding step ladder in her front room has changed nothing at all, because the thing that would have helped is the four rungs screwed to the wall beside that hatch in the dark with a ballcock on the top of a cistern, and she has been up ladders before and can do it, and she does not do this one, and on the same evening a man in a fleece comes to the gate with a fibreglass step ladder off his van to change the lamp on the bracket over that gate and she watches him from the kitchen window and does not go out and does not tell him there is another one in the house.
cards.0692: A woman in her early thirties has been up the road once in her life and tells her sister two things about it and neither of them is about the ladder, and her sister asks her who the ladder was from and she says she does not know, which is true, and that is the last time in these ten chapters that anybody asks anybody anything about the ladder and gets nothing, and it is not the first, because a man asked her at her own door on the seventh and a man from the coal yard asked her on the thirteenth, and the earliest of the three is a man asking her at her own door on the seventh whether she took a ladder out of his porch, and the shed still has a draught off the top of it and the ply is in the drawer and four of six is still four of six.
cards.0693: A man in his early forties who has not had his step ladder since the twenty-ninth of November is asked for one by the man at the bench opposite on a Monday morning and says he has lent his out and does not say to whom and does not say when it is coming back, and cannot ask the woman he lent it to without saying that he lent it, and spends most of a day on a job he would have done in a morning off a packing bench, and works out that the ladder is somewhere up the road where the card in his shirt pocket says twelve and does nothing about it.
cards.0694: A woman in her late forties is clearing a house and there is a step ladder folded against the wall of a back room with a strip of dark tape round its second rail and a chalk mark on its third tread, which are the marks of the ladder she put in a porch on the third of December, and SHE STANDS IN THE DOORWAY AND CANNOT TELL WHETHER IT IS THE SAME ONE AND SAYS SO OUT LOUD, and a man standing on the steps of his own father's house says it is his father's and she puts no line for it on her pad, and the box behind the passenger bench has not moved since the twenty-second of October and she still has not read the number on its label, and the drawer under that bench has been shut since the middle of November with her own bolster on the leads.
